sentences.english_text: He swung around again, and this time the sunlight shining through him turned him into a tiny, glorious rainbow.
And the little girl cried out, It's a rainbow!
It's a sign from God that He wants you to get well, her mother told her.
And the little girl said, Oh, yes, Mother, He sent me a rainbow!
And they were all pointing at Drippy.
And Drippy suddenly realized that they were talking about him.
They're talking about me.
I'm a rainbow.
I'm probably the most handsome rainbow in the world.
The doctor took the little girl's temperature, and it was normal.
And he said to the happy mother and father, She's going to live.
And the mother and father hugged their daughter.
I'm a hero.
I saved her life.
He saw his reflection in a mirror, and he had to admit that he made a beautiful rainbow.
So that's what the queen bee and the wind meant when they said, I had a special job to do.
And I was so important, they meant that I was a rainbow.
But at that moment, the sun moved away.
And when Drippy looked at his reflection again, he saw that he was just a plain little raindrop again.
So that was not what they had meant.
Then I must be important for some other reason, Drippy thought.
He looked at the little girl and said, But I'm still a hero.
It was time to get out of there.
It was time to go out and play again and have another adventure.
